title: Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B masked edit
description: Qualified manual-mask video editing for ordinary camera footage: the server normalizes source and mask into an aligned 16 FPS VACE envelope (up to 81 frames) and publishes 16 FPS output. No tracking, reference identity or extension.

evidence: End-to-end qualification on RTX 4090 / ComfyUI 0.37.0: validated 512x320 17-frame source and mask, durable submission, local generation, output validation, artifact import and browser playback. Scope is manual aligned-mask editing only; broader quality and offline operation are not qualified.
